Working on statistics, applied mathematics, and machine learning.

I use this site to think through statistical geometry, uncertainty, high-dimensional effects, and small empirical diagnostics.

These are notes and experiments — things worth writing down.

## Independence

This site contains personal academic notes and experiments. They are written independently, outside my employment, using personal equipment and public sources only. They do not contain confidential information, client data, employer materials, or employer know-how.
